recipes.name: A beds — Block plan
recipes.notes: Right-hand legend = block species (often paired, e.g. 'Echinacea + Dalea'); bottom legend = emergent symbols placed over blocks.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: B beds — Matrix plan
recipes.notes: Sporobolus heterolepis is the documented matrix grass; groups and scattered emergents sit within it.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: C beds — Organic grouping plan
recipes.notes: Upper legend = groups; lower legend headed 'Individual plants / small groups'.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: Triangles (Matrix)
recipes.notes: Statistics only (14 varieties: 6 forbs, 2 grasses, 6 trees & shrubs = 13 plants). Species not published: components unknown.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: Rain Garden
recipes.notes: Trees & shrubs from the March 2020 plan legend; perennials and sedges from the 2026 list.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: Bird Border hedgerow
recipes.notes: Nine mostly-native shrubs and small trees in two staggered rows; underplanting not itemised.
recipes.roleNote: Roles are the legend grouping of this recipe (how the species is drawn in this plan), not a global property of the species.

recipes.name: West Meadow
recipes.notes: Hydrology zones (Obligate wet 10cm / Facultative wet 5cm / Upland) are species attributes on the official list; their spatial zones are not published.
